missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend calcium supplementation until stone type, diet, kidney function and current products are clarified.
safety_exclusions: Do not advise indiscriminate calcium restriction; dietary calcium may be protective in some calcium oxalate stone contexts.
Do not assume all stones are calcium stones.
Do not recommend supplements without reviewing total intake and meal timing.
professional_escalation_conditions: Recurrent stones, calcium phosphate stones, hypercalciuria, chronic kidney disease or hypercalcemia.
Current stone episode, obstruction, severe pain, fever or hematuria.
population_and_context: Users with a history of kidney stones being assessed for calcium intake; stone composition, dietary calcium and supplemental calcium source/timing matter.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. If supplementation is clinically indicated, determine the dietary gap and product timing with meals in light of stone composition and clinician advice.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Calcium fact sheet provides general intake and safety information; stone prevention is individualized and should follow urology/nephrology guidance.
